item_name: Rothco Sheep Dog Deluxe Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Show your commitment to protecting and watching over others with Rothco’s Sheep Dog Deluxe Low Profile Cap. Made from 100% brushed cotton twill, this durable yet comfortable hat is designed for everyday wear. The front panel features bold "SHEEP DOG" embroidery alongside detailed sheep and dog artwork, creating a standout design. An integrated sweatband enhances comfort, keeping you cool during long hours of wear. The adjustable hook & loop closure on the back ensures a custom, snug fit for most head sizes.
